selection: Five private outfit expressions are the v2 artwork reference family. The user chose generation-time composition/pose guidance over coordinate fitting and numerical landmark gates. Main deployment and formal standard promotion remain separate.

geometry.cropPolicy: Close-up composition matching private family; intentional natural cut-off permitted, do not force v1 10% margins
geometry.placementPolicy: Use private/normal as composition and camera-distance example; refer to all five private expressions for acceptable natural variance
stableVisualFeatures: head tilt/angle (appearance, not fixed pixel angle)

geometryAnnotationStatus.method: historical visual approximation plus new enlarged 10px-grid check
geometryAnnotationStatus.uncertainty: Manual, eye-outline landmark boundaries partly obscured by eyelashes and hair; independent reviewer sign-off required.
geometryAnnotationStatus.next: Independent source-image landmark annotations and user visual sign-off; preserve calibrationPending gate.

historicalMeasurements.explanation: Retained only for audit provenance, NEVER used for automatic positional PASS/FAIL; earlier face coordinate methods conflated expressions with geometry.

requirements.basePortrait: Use the private five as visual guidance for framing and permitted expression changes; master/style/physique references keep their assigned authority.
requirements.samePoseExpression: Try to preserve hair/flower, outfit, torso, hand pose, lighting and camera framing as a whole, allowing natural brow/eyelid/eye/mouth/cheek/jaw differences.
requirements.outfitChange: Keep general head/camera framing from private five; allow legitimate differences in garment drape.
requirements.githubCopy: lossy WebP quality85 with true alpha and same dimensions
requirements.qa: Technical checks are automated; visual quality and expression-aware composition are judged after creation. No pixel-coordinate face standard.

qaEvidence.status: not calibrated: single-reviewer coordinate-grid estimates with ±8–12 px eye uncertainty

coordinateConflict.decision: Do not overwrite trial anchors until independently repeat-annotated

qaEvidence.step5Status: tentative 5px-grid annotated canthi / lid / chin only; blind-order single analyst; calibration not completed

step5AnchorAmbiguity.description: incompatible tentative landmark definitions and partial occlusion; do not promote
step5AnchorAmbiguity.note: correction candidate, second independent reviewer pending

qaEvidence.userSelection: Private five selected for composition and allowable expression variation; STEP4 and STEP5 comparison to gym smile is historical only
qaEvidence.releaseGate: geometry.anchors deliberately empty to preclude inadvertent certification against legacy gym smile values
qaEvidence.active: generation and visual review, not numerical landmarks
qaEvidence.previousCoordinateAudits: historical only; archived data has no PASS authority

primaryReferenceSet.geometryEvaluation: Expression-dependent eye, eyebrow, mouth and chin changes are allowed. Head framing must be checked with stable regions only; do not reject based solely on changing eye-aperture center or chin.

historicalGymSource.sourceOfTruth: project attachment for image-tool input; GitHub tracks specs and provenance, no automatic synchronization
historicalGymSource.note: Exact source binary already exists as the deployed gym/smile WebP at the fixed main SHA; a formal docs/shiori/reference master designation and image-tool input verification remain separate work.
historicalGymSource.role: historical v2 trial source and old smile composition only; NO LONGER PRIMARY REFERENCE

method: generation-time visual constraints + human visual acceptance + structural file checks

composition: all five private-v2 expressions, normal as layout representative
one private expression matching desired emotion if possible
inputs.outfit: the requested approved outfit reference, if applicable
inputs.inputConfirmation: File presence in GitHub/project is distinct from successful tool image input; verify actual source availability each time

hardConstraints: Output a portrait with exact 1086x1448 canvas (do not crop or stretch in postprocessing)
Export original with real transparent alpha PNG; convert separate display copy to lossy WebP quality85 preserving alpha
Do not add text, speech bubbles, UI, backgrounds or painted checkerboard
visualConstraints: Maintain the composition, approximate camera distance, head scale and head orientation seen in the private five reference family
Preserve character identity, dark-brown shoulder bob, purple eyes, single small pale flower ornament
For expression variants keep clothing/pose/hair/lighting broadly continuous; do not redraw them gratuitously
Allow natural eyebrow, eyelid, gaze, cheek, mouth/teeth and jaw changes; never force a smile/surprise onto the neutral eye/chin pixels
Outfit variants may change drape and garment silhouette, not the anatomical body or head scale
Keep strands coherent and avoid stray split hair ends in accordance with visual.md
Avoid awkwardly cut eyes, flower, fingers, jaw, and visible straight bottom canvas line
Ensure expression changes read clearly but do not cause unnatural jump of whole head in the app
afterProduction: Validate actual file format, pixel size, and transparent alpha mechanically
Manually compare side by side with all five references for head size, framing, likeness, outfit, expression naturalness and hair
Preview expression changes at one common Android viewport before acceptance; record unverified if not inspected
Production success does not equal user adoption, GitHub adoption, app deployment or device QA

machineChecks: reference source SHA provenance if an explicit source identifier is provided
humanReview: edge crop quality and alpha halos

resultLabels.technical: TECHNICAL PASS means only file structure
resultLabels.visual: VISUAL REVIEW REQUIRED until user/reviewer inspects
resultLabels.product: APP DISPLAY NOT VERIFIED until same-viewport preview
